name: The Fourfold Sovereignty of God
author: Cardinal Henry Edward Manning
desc: The Fourfold Sovereignty of God (1871): six lectures on the sovereignty of God over the intellect and the will of man, over society, in the divine Head of the Church, in the Church derived from that Head, and over the course of the world.
desc_pt: A Quadrupla Soberania de Deus (1871): seis conferências sobre a soberania de Deus sobre a inteligência e a vontade do homem, sobre a sociedade, na Cabeça divina da Igreja, na Igreja que dela deriva e sobre o curso do mundo.
editor: Henry Edward Manning (London: Burns, Oates and Co., 1871)
edition: The Fourfold Sovereignty of God (London: Burns, Oates and Co., 1871), Internet Archive full-text OCR.
srcnote: The six lectures; the contents and the publisher's list of books are dropped.
